text.tspan: Notes from a long read, kept as reference rather than as prose. A head…
Write `[[Note name]]` anywhere and trafford resolves it agains…
Start with [[How linking works]], then look at [[Reading a note]].
Renaming a note rewrites every link that pointed at it.
Keep the tally somewhere it will be seen. A note is a fine place.
See [[How linking works]] for how these notes connect.
